title: Measurement uncertainty
description: For agents reviewing shot-count results: return probabilities and binomial confidence intervals with the interval method and independence assumptions.

title: Quantum-state validity
description: Check a supplied single-qubit complex density matrix for unit trace, Hermiticity and positive semidefiniteness with explicit tolerance; no hardware validation.

title: Observable expectation values
description: Calculate X, Y and Z Pauli expectations for a supplied valid single-qubit density matrix. Returns basis conventions; not a hardware measurement.

title: State fidelity and purity
description: Calculate squared Uhlmann fidelity and purity for two supplied single-qubit density matrices. Explicit conventions; no experimental certification.

title: Coherence-budget calculator
description: Compare circuit durations with supplied T1/T2 values using an explicit relaxation/dephasing model. For scenario planning; not a measured device-fidelity guarantee.

title: Readout-calibration analysis
description: Invert a supplied single-qubit readout calibration and report sensitivity and nonphysical corrected fractions without clipping. Calibration uncertainty not estimated.

title: Quantum-circuit lint
description: Lint up to 128 declared gates on eight qubits for arity, target, angle and post-measurement errors. Returns scheduling depth; no simulation or equivalence proof.

title: Randomized-benchmarking fit
description: Fit supplied randomized-benchmarking decay observations with residuals and protocol-bound error estimates. Not a platform-independent quantum-computer ranking.

title: Rabi/Ramsey trace analysis
description: Fit a bounded damped Rabi/Ramsey trace by frequency-decay grid search; report residuals, resolution, aliasing refusal and edge hits. No parameter confidence interval.

title: Stabilizer consistency check
description: Check supplied stabilizer generators for commutation, independence and inconsistent constraints before analysing a code. No logical-error or fault-tolerance guarantee.

title: Surface-code resource scenario
description: Calculate a surface-code resource scenario under an explicitly named layout and supplied error assumptions. For planning; not a demonstrated physical implementation.

title: Quantum benchmark comparability
description: Compare structured benchmark protocol, workload, metric, noise and overhead declarations. Flags mismatches; labels are not independently validated.

title: Qubit architecture requirements map
description: Compare caller-declared qubit count, connectivity and gate-duration requirements with supplied architecture capability records. No verified best-platform recommendation.

title: FASTA quality check
description: Check supplied FASTA records for malformed headers, duplicate identifiers and invalid sequence characters before dataset ingestion. No functional or safety inference.

title: DNA/RNA composition
description: Count DNA/RNA bases and ambiguities and calculate GC fraction on called bases only. Refuses mixed DNA/RNA alphabets; no sequence design or clinical inference.

title: Protein sequence descriptors
description: Calculate composition, molecular mass and model-based charge descriptors from supplied protein sequences. For dataset analysis; not a folding or function prediction.

title: Pairwise sequence comparison
description: Globally align two DNA sequences of up to 400 bases using fixed Needleman-Wunsch scores; report aligned strings, identity and gaps. No pathogenicity inference.

title: Biological accession/version check
description: Match accession, isoform and version declarations against a caller-supplied hashed snapshot. Report missing or ambiguous matches; no authoritative database lookup.

title: Protein confidence-map audit
description: Summarize supplied per-residue pLDDT scores into explicit confidence bins. Does not assess missing residues, folding correctness, function or clinical suitability.

title: qPCR run-quality check
description: Check supplied Ct replicates, efficiency and control declarations against fixed research QC bands; report Ct SD and failed conditions. No diagnostic validation.

title: qPCR relative-expression calculator
description: Calculate a Pfaffl expression ratio from supplied Ct values and amplification efficiencies; require a declared stable reference. No diagnostic interpretation.

title: Assay-control coverage
description: Compare a declared assay with a reviewed control checklist and flag missing positive, negative, vehicle or technical controls. No experimental-success guarantee.

title: Research dose-response fit
description: Fit normalized assay responses using a fixed-bottom/top logit-linear Hill model. Return half-response, slope and residuals; no dosing or nonlinear-fit guarantee.

title: Replicate and batch-confounding check
description: Inspect structured sample assignments for technical/biological replication and batch confounding before comparing experimental groups. No causal conclusion from labels alone.

title: Biological translation-boundary check
description: Compare declared in-vitro, animal and human evidence frames against a requested claim frame. Flag mismatches; no truth certification or clinical endorsement.

title: Design-to-assay evidence brief
description: Check declared design hash, assay identity, evidence records and control gaps for a research handoff. Does not validate the design, sequence or biological efficacy.

title: Formula and molecular-mass check
description: Parse a bounded formula with parentheses using a pinned 30-element average-mass table. Return composition and molar mass; no isotopes, purity or safety claim.

title: Dilution calculator
description: Calculate stock and working concentrations from supplied quantities with unit and feasibility checks. For arithmetic verification; no chemical-handling or safety guidance.

title: Concentration-basis reconciliation
description: Reconcile molarity, mass concentration and fractions when required density and composition inputs exist. Flag missing assumptions; no invented material properties.

title: SMILES structure validation
description: Parse supplied SMILES and report valence, stereochemistry and representation problems before molecular-data processing. Structural parsing does not establish safety.

title: Molecular descriptor pack
description: Calculate a bounded set of molecular descriptors using a pinned toolkit version. For research dataset preparation; descriptors do not certify drug suitability or toxicity.

title: Molecular identity comparison
description: Compare supplied structures with explicit salt, protonation and stereochemical handling. For dataset reconciliation; no empirical identity or purity confirmation.

title: Fingerprint similarity
description: Compare supplied molecules using a declared fingerprint and similarity metric. For dataset analysis; chemical similarity does not establish equivalent function or safety.

title: Reaction conservation check
description: Check supplied reaction declarations for atom and charge accounting. For record quality control; no reaction feasibility, synthesis procedure or safety claim.

title: Spectrum peak-table comparison
description: Match supplied reference and sample peak lists under declared tolerances. For spectrum-data comparison; no unique compound identification from peaks alone.

title: Arrhenius fit
description: Fit positive rate-temperature observations by log-linear Arrhenius OLS; return activation energy, residuals and transformed-fit errors. No mechanism or extrapolation claim.

title: Electrochemical record normalizer
description: Convert electrode potentials with supplied SHE offsets only when declared conditions match. Explicit sign convention; no reference-data or area validation.

title: Enzyme-kinetics fit
description: Fit supplied substrate/rate pairs by reciprocal Lineweaver-Burk OLS; report Km, Vmax and residuals. Exposes noise bias; no parameter confidence interval.

title: Material-property record check
description: Check declared property, unit, temperature, method, uncertainty, source and revision against supported unit conventions. No independent measurement verification.

title: Particle-size distribution summary
description: Summarize supplied particle-size distributions while preserving number, mass or volume weighting. For metrology-data analysis; no toxicology or safety inference.

title: Thin-film sheet-resistance calculator
description: Relate supplied film thickness, resistivity and sheet resistance under stated uniform-film assumptions. For arithmetic checks; no measured device-performance claim.

title: Thermal-expansion mismatch
description: Estimate differential strain from supplied expansion coefficients and temperature changes. For preliminary scenarios; no stress, delamination or reliability certification.

title: Thermal-stack resistance
description: Calculate a one-dimensional layer and interface thermal-resistance scenario from supplied inputs. No hotspot, convection, transient or validated package-safety claim.

title: Stress-strain curve analysis
description: Extract supported metrics from bounded supplied stress-strain data under a declared method. Report fit and sampling limits; no structural design approval.

title: XRD peak-position analysis
description: Calculate first-order Bragg spacings from supplied two-theta peaks and wavelength. Explicit units; no lattice indexing or unique phase identification.

title: Optical band-gap fit audit
description: Evaluate supplied absorption observations under a declared band-gap model with fit-window sensitivity. No universal band-gap or integrated-device performance claim.

title: Raman reference comparison
description: Match supplied Raman peak positions by nearest unused reference within an absolute tolerance. No linewidth analysis or unique material identification.

title: Material-candidate comparison
description: Score supplied material candidates by weighted cohort min-max criteria; withhold incomplete scores without imputation. No qualification or engineering approval.

title: Deposition-process compatibility map
description: Check declared process temperature and corrosivity against substrate constraints and supplied evidence records. Flags conflicts; no fabrication recipe or compatibility approval.

title: Materials qualification evidence brief
description: Reconcile required qualification tests with supplied pass/fail/not-run evidence records. List declared passes, failures and gaps; no material certification.
